parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293227 (Ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 2). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
